guide.source: From the old www.tam.tv. Confirm details with TAM before relying on them.
regulars: Weekly, Saturday afternoons from 4pm. All musicians welcome to come and jam.
Hosted by guitarist Patrick Hinds: showcase your talent or enjoy the music.
Every week: TAM Singers, a live vocal talent search and recording project.
Hosted by Asha 'Keys' Elfenbein: fusion jazz with pop songwriting.
guide.food: Street food from over 20 cuisines from partners in and around Mercato Metropolitano. Only drinks bought from the TAM bar are allowed inside; the proceeds support TAM's artists.
guide.drinks: A full bar with cocktails, including piano drinks poured from taps built into old pianos.
guide.findUs: Inside Mercato Metropolitano, head towards the 'secret garden' and follow the signs for TAM.

hire.capacity: Up to 150 guests: 50–70 seated, 70–120 cocktail-style reception
hire.when: Any day of the week; rates depend on date and time
includes: Private bar with themed cocktails or mocktails
Stage and professional AV, projector included
Live music or karaoke on request
Professional sound and lighting for video shoots
Curated art and decorative pianos as a backdrop
